output.summary: KEP-1209 consolidates the four earlier Metrics Stability documents (framework, migration, validation and verification, and stability to beta) into one lifecycle document for implementing metrics stability in kubernetes/kubernetes and other consumers of component-base/metrics. Status is implemented, stage stable.
output.rationale: The earlier design was split across four documents, and this KEP ties them together to document the feature's lifecycle. The readme states it "is not net new". The status is implemented, with implementable from 2021-02-01 and implemented from 2021-04-08.

evidence.quote: This document is not net new and ties the four together in order to document the lifecycle of this feature.
This proposal covers the implementation of metrics stability in the kubernetes/kubernetes repo (and anywhere else that consumes `component-base/metrics`).
